blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The prosecution on Wednesday attempted to show a pattern of concealment involving around P96 million in funds from a Bank of the Philippine Islands (BPI) account jointly held by Vice President Sara Duterte and her father, former President Rodrigo Duterte. Prosecution counsel James Bryan Ibrahim Alih traced a series of manager’s checks that remained unutilized and were subsequently returned, saying the transactions showed how the funds could be moved out of the account without appearing in its year-end balance. The prosecution first traced P41.72 million from a time deposit that matured in March 2011 and was used to […]...
